# Kondō 1986 primary source

`ko1821.pdf` is the open-access Nagoya University dissertation copy of
Shigeyuki Kondō, *Enriques Surfaces with Finite Automorphism Groups* (1986).
The journal version is Japan. J. Math. (N.S.) **12** (1986), 191--282,
doi: [10.4099/math1924.12.191](https://doi.org/10.4099/math1924.12.191).

- repository record: <https://nagoya.repo.nii.ac.jp/records/4843>
- downloaded file: `ko1821.pdf` (9,875,342 bytes)
- SHA-256: `57be54fdd5e95324fe870f0fb69fc406022c4a13459e4a94de290a8d2fac6204`

The audit uses the Main Theorem and curve counts on internal pages 3--7,
Vinberg's specialized finite-index criterion on page 12, and the
no-hidden-nodal-curves proposition on page 13.  Two interrupted J-STAGE
downloads were not retained here; the complete repository copy has a valid
147-page PDF trailer.
